runtime.note: 后端、模型契约及前端资源来自启动时固定快照；任务数据与凭据独立使用原目录。Python依赖环境仍共用，不是完整依赖隔离。

checks: refreshed saved template remains in plan; no automatic table loading or code execution
wrong-node response rejected without replacing local fields or saved task
exact existing table and extracted order source fill only local form; confirmation resets
editing source while reading cancels stale form replacement
manually changed logic cannot be treated as original template; editor and saved plan preserved
modified records preview and adoption change only unsaved selected config, keeping all other branches
explicit save creates new revision, preserves old artifact history, and invalidates confirmation
same UI confirms configuration and downloads rebuilt native Chatflow with changed mock table
refresh can read updated canonical table again; no external action dispatched

limitations: Current exact-v1 content match only, not proof of origin or historical absence of edits.
Manual logic/comment/declaration changes are conservatively refused; no general Python-to-table importer.
Only existing root code templates and previously declared dependency/source; no arbitrary code or container extraction.
Explicit read replaces current local form fields, not the graph; a new preview, adoption, save and confirmation remain necessary.
Synthetic order data and static native rebuild, not real order service or Dify Sandbox/business acceptance.
